notes.title: Lower price for "Near Midnight"
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone. First, our team wants to apologise for the delusion around "Near Midnight" and the game's technical issues! 

We truly apreciate the feedback from you and we will take every word seriously!

From now on the price of "Near Midnight" will be 0.99 dollars, despite what kind of updates we make to the game.

If you have any questions, please contact us on this e-mail - thelostsymbol@mail.bg

Thank you! Have a great week!~

:))

notes.title: Early Stage of Development
notes.notes:
Hello, guys!

This is Radi from Real Games Studios and I want to make a few things clear for you, because the last thing we want is to delude you in some way.

The first thing I want to talk about is the game lenght at the moment. We will upload new content often so expect the game to get bigger and better every time we update it. 

Second, I want to share with you our thoughts about whether to refund because of the short game experience or not. As always, you are free to get a refund of your money! Because of the stage of game at the moment, we know that there will be a lot of people that will do that. I want to say that because of the fact that the price of "Near Midnight" will go up after a couple of updates, this is the perfect time for you to buy it and keep it. Of course, this is only if you find the title promising!

Last, but not least, we want to tell you that this is our first horror project and it's a little bit hard for us to polish some of the game aspects. If you think that you can help us make this game better in some way, please contact us here on Steam or via this e-mail adress - thelostsymbol@mail.bg

Thank you and have a wonderful week!
:))
